name: +1 Speed Escape in a Go Kart
desc:
🏎️ Welcome to +1 Speed Escape in a Go Kart!

How to Play:
• 🚗 Every kart makes you faster!
• 🏃 Tackle obstacles to earn wins!
• ⚡ Unlock powerful Karts that give insane speed multipliers!
• 💪 Train on treadmills or race around the map to get even faster!
• 🔥 Rebirth to gain multipliers and become even faster!

🔔 Follow for game updates! 
👍 Like the game for new Karts! 
👥 Invite your friends for a boost! 

💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
